title: A proportional-odds violation and the utility increments it meets
question: Does a proportional-odds violation bias a target-standardized expected-utility difference in proportion to the utility increments at the violated cut-point, and does relaxing proportional odds remove it?
design: Four-category ordinal outcome with proportional odds or a violation at the bottom or top cut-point; utilities with increments at the bottom or top; proportional-odds and separate cut-point logistic regressions standardized over a shifted target. 3 cells, 400 replicates each.
